decisions.reason: As a modular successor to an already accepted trommel screen, it is very close to the firm's existing screening knowledge and service routines, so management would usually keep refining it rather than withdraw it.

The mobile high-speed flail shredders remain well connected to the firm's core mobile processing competences, customer base, and field-service learning loops, which supports continued commercialization and improvement.

The stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's stationary plant expertise and resource-saving strategic direction, giving it enough related knowledge and improvement potential to justify staying in the portfolio.

Although the green-waste grinder is narrower and overlaps with other grinder offerings, it still builds on the firm's grinder know-how and installed customer relationships, so management would more likely keep than drop it.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are strongly aligned with the firm's established shredding capabilities and industrial customer applications, making them a product line the firm is well equipped to learn from and sustain.
